items.title: 20.4.3 Addition Reactions of Benzene (benzene ke addition reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.4.3 with Quick Check 20.8 answered, printed pages 67-68.

blocks.text: Ab hum benzene ki do addition reactions dekhenge: hydrogenation aur halogenation.
a) Hydrogenation of benzene (benzene par hydrogen jorna)

Benzene aur doosre arenes ki hydrogenation mein benzene ke carbons par hydrogen ke 1, 2 ya 3 moles jurte hain. Benzene ki poori hydrogenation se cyclohexane banta hai. Cyclohexane ek useful (kaam ka) solvent hai aur doosre chemicals banane ka precursor (khaam maal) hai.

blocks.alt: Benzene + 3H2 se cyclohexane, chhe CH2 groups ki ring. Methylbenzene + 3H2 se methylcyclohexane, aik CH (jis par CH3) aur paanch CH2 groups ki ring.
blocks.caption: Benzene aur methylbenzene ki hydrogenation (kitab ke PDF page 70 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke methylcyclohexane mein jis ring carbon par CH₃ laga hai use CH₂ likha hai; is tarah us carbon ke paanch bonds ho jate. Sahi: woh carbon CH hai (ek H, ek CH₃ aur do ring bonds).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen H₂ molecules ring ke teenon double bonds par jur jate hain aur ring saturated (sirf single bonds wali) ho jati hai: C₆H₆ + 3H₂ → C₆H₁₂. Methylbenzene isi tarah methylcyclohexane deta hai.

Yeh reactions benzene ring ki electron delocalisation khatam kar deti hain, kyun ke woh electrons naye hydrogen atoms se bond banane mein lag jate hain. Naye C–H bonds strong (mazboot) hain, is liye reactions overall (kul mila kar) exothermic (heat dene wali) hain, lekin in ki activation barrier (shuru hone ki rukawat) oonchi hai. In mein wahi finely divided (bareek pisa hua) nickel catalyst use hota hai jo alkenes ki hydrogenation mein hota hai, aur temperature bhi milta julta (taqreeban 150°C) hai, lekin pressure zyada rakha jata hai.
b) Addition of Halogens (halogens ka jurna)
Chlorine aur bromine ek hi tarah react karte hain. Catalyst ke baghair UV roshni aur heat poori halogenation ke liye kaafi hain. Benzene ki poori chlorination neeche dikhai gayi hai:

blocks.alt: Benzene + 3Cl2, arrow ke oopar UV, heat, se hexachlorocyclohexane: single bonds ki six-membered ring, har carbon par aik H aur aik Cl.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki complete chlorination (kitab ke PDF page 71 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen Cl₂ molecules jurte hain aur har carbon par ek H aur ek Cl hota hai: C₆H₆ + 3Cl₂ → C₆H₆Cl₆ (1,2,3,4,5,6-hexachlorocyclohexane). Yahan catalyst nahi; catalyst (AlCl₃ ya FeCl₃) ke saath substitution hoti, addition nahi.

blocks.alt: Benzene ring jis ke baari baari carbons par teen groups: oopar isopropyl, CH(CH3)2, neeche left CH3 aur neeche right 2-methylpropyl, CH2CH(CH3)2. Label: 3-isobutyl-5-isopropyltoluene.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 20.8 ka compound (kitab ke PDF page 71 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is compound ka naam '3-Ethyl-5-propyloluene' likhti hai, lekin drawing mein ethyl ya propyl group nahi: is mein isopropyl, CH(CH₃)₂, methyl aur 2-methylpropyl (isobutyl), CH₂CH(CH₃)₂, groups hain. Sahi naam 3-isobutyl-5-isopropyltoluene hai. Jawab dono cases mein ek hi hai: benzene-1,3,5-tricarboxylic acid.

blocks.prompt: i. Upar bane compound ko acidified KMnO₄ ya K₂Cr₂O₇ se oxidise karne par kya banega?
blocks.explanation: Teenon side chains ke ring wale carbon par benzylic hydrogen hai, is liye teenon –COOH ban jati hain: benzene-1,3,5-tricarboxylic acid.

blocks.prompt: ii. AlBr₃ ki presence (mojoodgi) mein chlorobenzene mein bromine dalne par kya banega?
blocks.explanation: Cl ortho-para director hai, is liye ring par ortho aur para positions par substitution hoti hai: zyada tar 1-bromo-4-chlorobenzene aur kuch 1-bromo-2-chlorobenzene, saath HBr.

blocks.prompt: iii. Nitrobenzene ko Ni ki presence mein zyada temperature aur pressure par reduce karne se kya banega?
blocks.explanation: Nitro group amino group ban jata hai: aniline, C₆H₅NH₂, aur paani. In tough (sakht) conditions mein kaafi hydrogen ho to ring ki bhi hydrogenation ho kar cyclohexylamine ban sakta hai.

items: Hydrogenation: C₆H₆ + 3H₂ → cyclohexane (Ni, taqreeban 150°C, zyada pressure).
Halogen addition: C₆H₆ + 3Cl₂ → C₆H₆Cl₆ (UV roshni aur heat, catalyst nahi).
Addition aromatic delocalisation khatam karta hai, is liye tough (sakht) conditions chahiye.
